data.cultural_impact: The name "Shantu" in Hindu culture symbolizes the bringing of peace, calmness, and serenity. It is often used as a name for boys as a reminder of the evasive yet important qualities of tranquility and peace. In Hindu culture, names often hold deep significance and reflect the desired qualities for the individual to embody and nurture throughout their life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name "Shantu" holds great importance as it signifies the inner peace and calmness that one aspires to achieve through spiritual practices. It is believed that by embracing the name "Shantu," one can tap into the realm of inner peace and tranquility, enabling them to lead a contented and serene life. In Hinduism, the pursuit of inner peace and stillness of the mind is considered essential for spiritual growth and liberation.

historical_references.reference:
Shantu was a celebrated king of the Vatsa kingdom in Magadha during the 3rd century BC. He is known for his peace-loving nature and is believed to have ruled during the period of Buddhist emperor Ashoka.
Context: Ancient Indian History.

Shantu is also mentioned in the Hindu epic Mahabharata as the name of a sage who was a revered teacher and advisor to the Pandava prince Bhima. He is known for his wisdom and peaceful demeanor.
Context: Hindu Mythology.
